title: Emil Hünten's Preliminaries
content: Emil Johann Hünten(1827 - 1902) was a German military painter who studied in Paris and Düsseldorf.Emil Hünten, Frederick the Great on horsebackHe produced his oil canvases only after careful preliminary study from life.Those studies were typically made from costumed models in three different media: 1) Oil studies...2) Watercolor studiesand 3) Tone paper with pencil and gouache. He probably also used lay figures and maquettes.----More aboutEmil Hüntenon Wikipedia
